visual_action: A static image resembling a flyer is displayed for the entire duration of the video. The flyer has a white background and features a portrait photo of an older man with gray hair in a suit and tie. Black text is arranged above and below the photo.

cast.name: Jerome Powell
cast.evidence: His name, 'JEROME POWELL', and his portrait photograph are featured prominently on the on-screen text graphic.

on_screen_text.text: DON'T FIRE JEROME POWELL SCHOOL WALKOUT

spoken_summary: There is no spoken dialogue in the video; it consists only of a rap song with lyrics.
audio_music: A modern, upbeat rap track ('FDO' by Pooh Shiesty) plays throughout the video, creating a stark, likely ironic, contrast with the static, serious-looking visual content about an economic figure.
central_claim: The post satirically frames Federal Reserve Chair Jerome Powell as a hero to young people, suggesting a 'school walkout' is being organized to prevent him from being fired.
intended_effect: To create amusement and confusion through an absurd juxtaposition of a government official, a youth protest format, and rap music, likely encouraging shares as a meme.
uncertainty_flags: The specific target of the satire is unclear; it could be mocking Jerome Powell, his supporters, the concept of school walkouts, or simply be absurdist humor.
